item.title: Becky G’s Eclectic New Album ‘Baraja Bendita’ Is Here: Stream It Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about the latest release from Becky G. Her fifth studio album, Baraja Bendita, just dropped via RCA Records.
[Short music transition]
Host: This 17-track album is all about embracing duality and freedom. Becky G bridges her artist persona and her real name, Rebbeca, to create a musical symbol of self-acceptance. As she puts it, "It's about trusting myself enough to stop choosing between different parts of who I am."
[Short music clip from the album]
Host: Baraja Bendita marks a departure from her previous música mexicana-leaning projects. This time, Becky G proudly showcases her 100% American and 100% Mexican identity, blending different styles and genres like kizomba, R&B, bachata, and reggae.
[Short music clip from the album]
Host: What's notable about this album is that Becky G wrote all the tracks herself, without any collaborations. The result is a collection of songs that balance vulnerability and confidence, instinct and intention.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Baraja Bendita, which translates to "blessed deck of cards," is Becky G's fifth LP, following her successful albums Mala Santa, Esquemas, Esquinas, and Encuentros. You can stream Baraja Bendita now and experience the evolution of Becky G's music for yourself.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
